source: Gemma 2, PaLM, Qwen3, and others illustrate important variants. “ZXNAME0000XZ changes the whole block.” It changes attention’s Q/K/V head structure. “ZXNAME0001XZ means a different Transformer skeleton.” It commonly replaces the feed-forward branch with routed experts. “The KV cache stores the whole block state.” It stores attention K/V or an architecture-specific equivalent. “Attention always dominates compute.” The bottleneck depends on shape, phase, architecture, and hardware.
zh: Gemma 2、PaLM、Qwen3 等说明了重要的变体。 “ZXNAME0000XZ 改变了整个区块。”它改变了注意力的Q/K/V头部结构。 “ZXNAME0001XZ 表示不同的变形金刚骨架。”它通常用路由专家代替前馈分支。 “KV 缓存存储整个块状态。”它存储注意力 K/V 或特定于架构的等效项。 “注意力总是主导计算。”瓶颈取决于形状、阶段、架构和硬件。
